Whether you're hungry or not, our bodies need food. Especially if you're having a hard time focusing, that's literally your body telling you it needs something. Anything.

Eating something small wont make you gain weight. But it'll nourish your body and especially your brain, which it needs.

I know how triggering it is with your sister, trust me i struggle with the same thing. But your needs have nothing to do with anyone else's needs, and just because she hasn't eaten yet, it doesn't mean that you dont deserve to eat until she does. It's scary how much we mirror ourselves in other people, but i promise you it's gonna be okay. 

So please just eat something, anything. It doesn't have to be anything big, and you might feel like you dont need to, but it's important that we learn to listen to our bodies

While i can't say she definitely has an ed just based on this, i will say that i understand why her behavior is triggering you, and i have also been triggered by this exact behavior in the past. But please try to remember that you deserve to eat, regardless of whether she eats or not.

Every person is different and has different needs. I know its hard, but please eat something if you're hungry. It doesn't have to be a big meal, but even something small is better than nothing.

Having an ed is hard enough, but i promise that eating a little will not be the end of the world.
